objective: Evaluate the immutable sealed native LayerCake payload through the exact receiver on the same 28-prompt natural-English screen used for ABI-derived candidates, so new-scope quality failures are not automatically mislabeled as ABI-only failures.

claim_boundary.locked_layercake_phase2_result: Remains PASS in its existing bounded scope and is neither rerun nor broadened by this control.
claim_boundary.matched_quality_control: Observational attribution evidence only; it does not certify ABI transfer and does not alter historical LayerCake evidence.
claim_boundary.abi: No teacher extraction, ABI payload training, or ABI candidate is executed here.

decision_rule.all_28_pass_and_zero_collapse: The native host has a known-good payload for the full candidate quality scope; later installed candidate quality failures may be attributed to ABI acquisition or integration after all earlier ABI gates pass.
decision_rule.at_least_10_pass_and_zero_collapse: The native payload clears only the existing preliminary ABI screen, not the full quality scope; attribution must distinguish screen-level from full-quality claims.
decision_rule.below_10_or_any_collapse: The locked Phase 2 proof remains valid, but the native payload does not establish the broader ABI target scope. Installed candidate misses are ABI/acquisition-or-new-host-scope unresolved until an oracle same-topology control passes. Do not call them LayerCake regressions or ABI-only failures.
decision_rule.execution_or_identity_failure: LAYERCAKE_HOST_REGRESSION_OR_CONTROL_INVALID; stop ABI payload work until resolved.

final_test_accessed: The catalog was already disclosed and used by V72-V75; this run creates no new prompts and does not access any separately held-out promotion test.
